item.title: Sector Update: Tech Stocks Mixed Late Afternoon
item.description: 03:47 PM EDT, 08/26/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks were mixed late Wednesday afternoon with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) ris
item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:47 PM EDT, 08/26/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks were mixed late Wednesday afternoon with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) rising 0.6% and the State Street SPDR S&P Semiconductor ETF (XSD) easing 0.1% The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was little changed. In corporate news, Meta Platforms (META) agreed to pay a maximum of $16.68 billion to resolve claims brought by several US states that the tech giant used its platforms to "ensnare" youth and teens, according to a filing in federal court. Meta shares rose 1.2%. Amazon-backed (AMZN) Anthropic will spend $45 billion to rent about 460 megawatts of AI cloud computing power from Nscale's flagship data center in West Virginia over six years, Bloomberg reported. Amazon shares fell 0.4%. Zoom Communications (ZM) shares fell 6.6% after the company provided a downbeat earnings outlook for fiscal Q3 following a Q2 beat. Intuit (INTU) shares dropped 3.9%, a day after the company issued a soft fiscal 2027 outlook.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ortelius posted January–June 2026 net sales of MSEK 26.4, while operating loss widened to MSEK 19.9. Profit after tax deepened to a loss of MSEK 24.5; earnings per share were SEK -0.3. April–June net sales fell to MSEK 10.7, while operating loss widened to MSEK 10.7. Second-quarter net loss deepened to MSEK 14.0; the company cited terminated and delayed customer projects. item.content:encoded: Alpha Star Acquisition posted a Q2 net loss of $142,258, versus a $137,495 loss a year earlier. item.title: Silvercorp highlights Kyrgyzstan gold pipeline anchored by Tulkubash, Kyzyltash projects with about 6 Moz resource

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Silvercorp outlined a growth plan that shifts revenue mix toward copper and gold through projects in Ecuador and Kyrgyzstan. El Domo project economics: after-tax NPV8% USD 571 million, IRR 46%, payback about 3 years; commissioning targeted for July 2027. El Domo average annual payable output over years 1-11: 24 million lb copper, 27,000 oz gold, 26 million lb zinc. Tulkubash Phase 1 budgeted construction spend USD 166.3 million; updated BFS expected in September 2026; annual production about 110,000 oz gold. Kyzyltash drilling program set up a 2027 PEA, 2028 feasibility and engineering; target production profile cited at about 200,000 oz gold annually.
